system.description:
At your call the dead rise in skeletal hordes and withered masses, laboring and fighting without regard for their own ruin until they are destroyed.

Expend a Willpower Trait, then invest one Mental Trait and one Blood Trait for each corpse animated. So long as the body is reasonably intact it rises to serve. These guardians have four health levels (fewer if badly damaged), suffer no wound penalties, and fight with the Physical Traits they possessed in life (assume five for a random corpse). They can attack or guard as ordered and wait tirelessly until destroyed; decay continues except in wholly skeletal servants.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.bloodCost: 1 Willpower Trait + 1 Blood Trait per corpse
